verdicts.rationale: The mines are a damage-only mechanic: the skill's effects array is empty and the mines deal AoE Pyro DMG with no buff/heal/shield/shred, so there is no non-damage effect the timeline silently omits — damage numbers/AoE are constitution-excluded. The E carries no authored summon subrow, so there is no rendered surface the timeline visibly diverges from; the omission is purely of damage content. Implement is also blocked: the note flags mine duration and spawnsAt as needing KQM verification, so authoring a summon would mean faking timing (against the never-fake-timing convention), and a damage-only mine detonation is a damage-proc render surface, explicitly off the implement list. The note itself is curator representation talk, not a decision-relevant user-facing divergence.
rubricRefs: Out of scope by constitution: damage numbers/math
no rendered surface to diverge from (noCaveat)
